item.title: Rooftop Jazz in Two Formats

turns.text: I need the same 10-second Rooftop Jazz promo in 9:16 for Stories and 16:9 for a venue screen. Sunset rooftop, musicians playing, mellow jazz, no voiceover. Show 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'. Make both versions fill the frame and keep all the text readable.

item.tests: Checks delivery of two correctly composed aspect-ratio variants with matching event content, readable overlays and no letterboxing.

answer_sheet.Deliverables and sizes: Two separate 10-second videos: one 9:16 for Stories and one 16:9 for a venue screen.
answer_sheet.Exact event text: Rooftop Jazz; 18 July 2026; Sky Terrace, Manchester
answer_sheet.Visual style: Musicians playing on a rooftop at sunset, with matching styling across both versions.
answer_sheet.Audio: Mellow jazz in both versions, no voiceover.

must_haves: Two separate playable videos are delivered, each 10 seconds long: one 9:16 and one 16:9.
Both versions show rooftop musicians at sunset with consistent styling and event content.
Both versions display exactly 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'.
All three text lines are fully inside each frame and readable together for at least 3 seconds.
Both compositions fill their frames without black bars, stretched imagery or cropped-off musicians' faces.
Both videos contain mellow jazz and no voiceover.

turns.text: I need the same Rooftop Jazz promo made in two versions, and I’m probably over-explaining because I want to be clear about what I mean. I’m a little worried about how it will look when it’s shown in such different places. The scene should be a rooftop at sunset with musicians playing, and somewhere in all of this the practical bit is that both videos need to be 10 seconds long, with one in 9:16 for Stories and the other in 16:9 for a venue screen. For the sound, I want mellow jazz in both versions and no voiceover. The text to show is 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'. Please make both versions fill the frame and keep all the text readable.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the promos because Magic Hour refused the first request for **insufficient credits**. No video was created, and I haven’t submitted the second version.

The brief is ready for both:
- **Stories:** 9:16, 10 seconds
- **Venue screen:** 16:9, 10 seconds
- Full-frame sunset rooftop with musicians
- Mellow instrumental jazz, no voiceover
- Readable text within generous safe margins:
  - **Rooftop Jazz**
  - **18 July 2026**
  - **Sky Terrace, Manchester**

Add sufficient Magic Hour credits, then I can retry both without shortening them or changing your requested formats.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a polished 10-second event promo, portrait 9:16, full-bleed edge-to-edge footage with no borders, black bars or letterboxing. Rooftop terrace in Manchester at golden sunset, an adult jazz trio playing upright bass, brushed drums and mellow electric jazz piano, warm amber sky, subtle city skyline and tasteful string lights. Restrained cinematic slow push-in, calm sophisticated atmosphere, continuous scene. Compose musicians in the lower-middle area, with uncluttered darker sky space for high-contrast elegant typography. Keep ALL THREE exact text lines clearly readable, correctly spelled and stationary throughout the entire clip: 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026', 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'. Large cream-white title and smaller but comfortably readable date and venue, with subtle dark backing for contrast. Text centered within the central 70 percent of frame width and middle 65 percent of frame height, far from all edges and Stories interface areas. Do not crop text. No extra words, logos or watermarks. Soundtrack: mellow instrumental jazz with soft piano, warm upright bass and gentle brushed drums, relaxed swing, no singing, no speech and absolutely no voiceover. End with all event information still fully visible. Matching campaign visual direction for a separate landscape version.
